text: Take a few akshintalu and a little water in your hand, and make the sankalpam with devotion.
"I, {name}, born in the {gotra} gotra, on this Vijayadashami day, worship Sri Rajarajeshwari Devi with devotion, that our family may have victory, health, peace and good fortune."
Then let the akshintalu fall into the puja plate.
